statusText: Mapped policy state: BLOCK_NEW_BASE_ENTRIES. Latest verified reporting and fresh supplementary context show the Sunday NQ gap still largely intact into early Asia, with oil and regional risk stress elevated, while renewed one-way extension is not verified.
recommendation: Mapped policy state: BLOCK_NEW_BASE_ENTRIES. Tail is minimally elevated because NQ remains materially weaker than broader futures and the reopening gap has persisted, but limited direct live pullback evidence and no renewed extension cap escalation.
headline: Persistent Sunday NQ gap keeps Tail minimally elevated into early Asia
body: Reuters reported at 23:11 UTC that Nasdaq futures were about 1.0% lower versus 0.5% for S&P futures, with Nikkei futures down 2% and Brent above $107. Fresh supplementary Finviz context collected at 23:41 UTC still showed NQ near -1.0%; direct live pullback structure remains incomplete.

lookbackSummary: Across the preceding 24 clock-hours, 22 assessments were green at Tail 19, the 22:00 UTC reopening moved to WATCH at Tail 24, and 23:00 UTC rose to elevated Tail 27 as the technology-sensitive gap held with oil stress. Stress was extreme from 03:00 UTC onward.
outlookSummary: Tail remains minimally elevated while the Sunday gap is still largely held. The path can normalize quickly if Asia produces deeper retracements and two-way trade; renewed NQ downside efficiency, shallow rebounds, or fresh oil/geopolitical escalation would keep Tail elevated.

forecast.analysis: Reuters at 23:11 UTC had NQ about 1.0% lower versus ES about 0.5% lower; fresh supplementary Finviz context collected at 23:41 still showed NQ near -1.0%. The gap was still largely held, but direct live pullback structure remains incomplete and no renewed extension is verified.
drivers: Direct live pullback evidence remains incomplete

forecast.analysis: Tail eases to WATCH conditionally if Tokyo trade produces a deeper NQ retracement or stops relative underperformance. Continued holding near the overnight low with oil firm would keep the path-risk case stronger.

WATCH persists conditionally as Asian liquidity deepens. A broader two-way range and recovering technology futures would weaken the persistent-gap case; renewed downside extension would reverse that easing.

Tail declines conditionally if the initial reopening shock is absorbed without repeated failed rebounds. The key checkpoint is whether the overnight range broadens rather than printing fresh lows with shallow pullbacks.
Low Tail returns conditionally if meaningful retracement capacity is visible by late Asia. Energy disruption can keep Stress extreme even when the NQ path itself becomes less one-directional.
Low Tail is retained conditionally if late-Asia trade remains two-sided and the gap stops extending. A fresh oil spike or renewed NQ downside efficiency would invalidate this normalization.
WATCH returns conditionally into the Europe pre-open as liquidity expands. The main test is whether NQ holds near overnight extremes or continues to retrace the Sunday gap.
The Europe cash open is a transmission checkpoint. Tail rises conditionally if European technology weakness and oil strength reinforce NQ downside while rebounds remain shallow.
Early European trade keeps WATCH conditionally if cross-asset pressure remains aligned. A durable NQ rebound and softer oil would reduce path risk even if headline Stress stays high.
Tail eases conditionally if Europe develops a balanced range and NQ no longer underperforms broader U.S. futures. Renewed session-low tests would keep WATCH active.
WATCH remains conditional through mid-Europe because the Sunday gap still matters for U.S. premarket positioning. Deeper retracements would support further normalization.
Tail edges higher conditionally as U.S. premarket liquidity begins to dominate. Persistent NQ relative weakness, firm oil and rising volatility would be the main amplifiers to monitor.
The U.S. premarket is a conditional checkpoint for whether the overnight gap survives broader participation. Tail rises if NQ remains near lows while ES and rates fail to stabilize.

The 13:30 UTC U.S. cash open falls inside this hour. Tail reaches the top of WATCH conditionally because an opening-auction continuation with shallow pullbacks would be the clearest near-term escalation signal.
The first full U.S. cash hour stays WATCH conditionally. Repeated extension after failed rebounds would lift Tail; a strong retracement back into the overnight gap would lower it.
Tail eases conditionally if the first cash-hour move becomes two-sided and NQ stops holding near session extremes. Oil and yields remain important confirmation or conflict inputs.
Mid-session path risk continues to normalize conditionally if retracements remain available. A new technology-led downside leg would challenge that assumption.
Tail stays near the lower WATCH boundary conditionally as afternoon liquidity develops. The critical distinction is choppy digestion versus renewed efficient trend extension.
A modest WATCH buffer returns conditionally ahead of the late session because unresolved geopolitical and rates stress can re-amplify an otherwise balanced equity tape.
Power-hour risk lifts Tail conditionally. Persistent NQ downside into the final cash hour, especially with firm oil and volatility, would strengthen the one-way-path case.
Around the U.S. cash close, Tail remains WATCH conditionally while late positioning is assessed. A close near session lows after failed rebounds would keep risk elevated into Globex.
Post-cash Tail eases conditionally if closing pressure does not extend into evening futures. Two-way trade would argue for continued normalization despite extreme macro Stress.
Late-evening Tail sits at the WATCH threshold conditionally. Fresh geopolitical headlines or another oil acceleration could quickly re-open the overnight danger window.

Tail remains WATCH conditionally into the next Asia handoff if the market has not fully repaired the Sunday gap. Stable cross-assets and visible retracement capacity would favor lower risk thereafter.

forecastDetail.comment: NQ is still about 1% lower with the gap largely intact, but no fresh extension beyond the initial reopening shock is verified; Tail remains minimally elevated.
WATCH is conditional on Tokyo producing some retracement or at least stopping further efficient downside extension.
Asian two-way trade would support easing; renewed lows with shallow rebounds would keep Tail higher.
The risk path improves if the overnight range broadens without repeated failed rebounds.
Low Tail is conditional on visible retracement capacity even while geopolitical and oil Stress remains extreme.
Late-Asia normalization remains conditional; renewed NQ efficiency or another oil spike would invalidate it.
